evidence.text:
Reason for referral: Evaluation of a recent fainting episode with transient loss of
consciousness.

Findings: Normal sinus rhythm at 70 bpm. Normal axis. PR interval 151 ms, QRS 108 ms, QTc
417 ms.
Impression: Normal sinuus rhythm with no acute ST-T wave changes.
Most recent echo showed an ejection fraction of 40%.

Findings: Normal left ventricular size. Left ventricular ejection fraction estimated at
65%. Mild mitral regurgitation. No pericardial effusion.
Impression: Normal left ventricular systolic function.

LIPID PANEL
Total Cholesterol: 221 mg/dL (H)
LDL Cholesterol: 137 mg/dL (H)
HDL Cholesterol: 54 mg/dL
Triglycerides: 154 mg/dL (H)

BASIC METABOLIC PANEL
Sodium: 136 mmol/L
Potassium: 5.0 mmol/L
Chloride: 106 mmol/L
CO2: 28 mmol/L
BUN: 8 mg/dL
Creatinine: 0.7 mg/dL
Glucose: 101 mg/dL (H)
Calcium: 9.9 mg/dL

Metoprolol tartrate 25 mg by mouth twice daily
Lisinopril 10 mg by rnouth once daily
Metformin 500 mg by mouth twice daily
Levothyroxine 50 mcg by mouth once daily
Warfarin 5 mg by mouth once daily

EXAM:
General: alert, no acute distress.
Neck: supple, no jugular venous distension.
Cardiac exam: regular rate and rhythm, norrnal S1 and S2, no murmurs, rubs, or gallops.
Lungs: clear bilaterally.
Extremities: trace ankle ederna.
